component.name: ProtectEye
component.summary: Evidence-Based Cross-Platform Eye Health & Break Assistant

description.p: ProtectEye is a modern, lightweight, cross-platform eye health and digital ergonomics assistant built with C++20 and Qt6. It helps combat digital eye strain (asthenopia) and evaporative dry eye disease through peer-reviewed ophthalmological routines:

ul.li: 20-20-20 Rule endorsed by the American Academy of Ophthalmology (AAO) and American Optometric Association (AOA)
Meibomian gland lipid expression blinking exercises based on Dr. Donald Korb's dry eye protocols
Smooth pursuit extraocular muscle exercises running at 0.16–0.20 Hz
Parasympathetic resets with 0.125 Hz coherent breathing and panoramic vision expansion
Ergonomic posture micro-breaks aligned with NIOSH, OSHA, and Cornell University Ergonomics Web

screenshot.caption: Interactive 60 FPS Eye Break Overlay with Guided Exercises
Native Preferences Dialog with 11-Language and Schedule Configuration

description.p: Fixed break overlay text behavior when interactive eye exercise animations are disabled to display clean break badges and clinical rest tips instead of animation instructions. Enhanced Do Not Disturb (DND) silent break skipping across Windows and all Linux desktop environments (GNOME, KDE Plasma 5/6, XFCE, Cinnamon, MATE, COSMIC, Sway, Hyprland) with fullscreen window detection and pre-break warning suppression. Improved cross-platform autostart with AppImage persistence support, robust desktop flags, and system-wide masking.

Robust multi-tier update checking with CDN fallback to resolve rate limit and connection issues, automatic update checks on every application startup, native desktop manager notifications (FreeDesktop DBus on Linux, Action Center Toast on Windows) with clickable action buttons, and bundled Windows TLS plugins.

Added 'protecteye update' CLI command for automatic GitHub release updates across Linux distributions (Arch, Debian, Fedora) and Windows. Fixed Interface Language dropdown popup styling to ensure consistent dark theme and high readability across all desktop environments.

Reorganized Preferences dialog into a compact, modern 3-tab layout (Schedules, Smart Features, General & Updates) with scroll area guarantees, perfectly optimized for laptops and smaller screens. Configured Clangd compilation database export for IDE support.

Full multi-monitor eye break overlay coverage across Wayland, X11, and Windows, versioned Windows setup installer (ProtectEye_<version>_Setup.exe), and automated single source of truth version management.
Fixed long break snooze behavior to prevent unintentional override of short break timers, improved build tool detection across distributions.
Comprehensive release with 11 top spoken languages (including Arabic RTL layout), robust Wayland and Windows 10/11 compatibility, smart DND integration, and clinical eye exercise routines.
